content: {"praised":["Actors, sets, costumes, cars, and dialogue were well‑done.","Geraldine McEwan’s portrayal of Miss Marple was enjoyable.","The collection offers over 19 hours of engaging mysteries.","The series is entertaining and accessible for mystery fans.","The production quality of visuals and music is solid."],"criticized":["Plots and characters were grossly altered from the books.","Opening segments felt like cheesy old horror movies.","Miss Marple’s character was transformed unacceptably.","Scripts lacked insight and integrity of Christie’s work.","Subtitles for the hearing impaired were missing in the release."]}
